name: Hatano Rin
source:
A literature loving girl who attends Shuuhei high school.

She grew up with her single father, the novelist Hatano Shuuhou. Now that her father has passed away, she lives off the royalties of his works. Her academic performance isn't remarkable, and she spends her time reading books silently in a corner of the classroom.

Imagining her struggling with a particularly complicated math problem is extremely adorable.

There is a certain depth to her each expression and movement, perhaps acquired after so much time in solitude, or maybe it's all the reading informing the deep aura she exudes. It is the kind of aloof and ethereal energy that stirs the sense of wonder and the desire of many older men.

Whether unconscious or not, it is the kind of energy that makes one feel appropriate even gazing at her visage.

Whenever dirty topics come up among the students, she neither runs away or shows disgust, instead choosing to quirk her bewitching smile, capturing the heart of many a young pretender.

Truly, she is the forbidden fruit of the garden.

[Edited from [url=https://laplacian.jp/yonagi/en]Laplacian[/url]]
